marriotts-way-races|2027-02-21.summary: Point-to-point marathon and half-marathon trail routes along Marriott’s Way, finishing in Aylsham.

Marathon.note: Janice of Boghopper Races confirmed directly by email on 23 October 2026: marathon 08:30 GMT. This supersedes the 09:00 timetable interpretation recorded on 21 October. Coach availability caused the earlier inconsistencies. One mass start for runners and walkers; gun-timed start and chip-timed finish. The organiser reported correcting the website and registration platform. Earlier source evidence is retained as history.
